connection.method: CLI app connect B; independently matched authenticated connection in both support bundles

changes: Only NORMAL priority of the three dedicated locked source-input OS threads receives a best-effort ABOVE_NORMAL (+1) hint at thread startup.

Explicit lower/higher priority, native lookup/set failures and original owner completion are preserved. No new recovery error, process priority, dynamic boost, affinity, timeout or foreground proof change.
Each OS thread stays locked through goroutine exit and is retired, so elevated priority cannot leak to the general Go thread pool.
validation: Six related suites passed: wininput, handoff, inputworker, residentagent, productlog, localapi.

Five related packages passed standard vet; wininput passed the existing CI policy vet -unsafeptr=false. Full wininput vet has eight pre-existing unsafe.Pointer warnings in unchanged callback files; no new warning suppressed.
Selected owner priority, source activation/completion/reply/shutdown/heartbeat tests passed with race detection in wininput and inputworker.
Real Windows owner-thread test observed +1 priority for all three owner variants and preserved original nil/error completion; policy tests cover eight priorities and native failure.
Workspace/frontend tests/build and setup bundle verification passed.
Exact A CLI/UI/agent/installed and B peer g526 revisions verified, both protected services/input health READY, and same authenticated connected session.
Live A protected source child has exactly three thread base priorities of 9, versus zero before install; both protected process base priorities remain 8. No B thread-priority proof is claimed.
limits: g525 had 15 complete pairs, an 808.306ms tail and correlated A CPU saturation. Scheduling mitigation is not yet an observed g526 latency improvement.
Native window/foreground operations may still block on another process or the OS even after input owner priority rises.
Best-effort hint failure preserves normal functionality; successful startup does not alone prove that priority was elevated on every device.
Initial connection observation does not establish CPU-pressure/endurance or recurrence prevention.
apiDBRunner: No API, private/peer wire format, JSON schema, DB, dependency or runner changes. Source thread scheduling and generation only.
